verdict.rationale: Grafana supports provisioning-as-code, an official CLI for authentication/administration suitable for CI/CD pipelines, and observability-as-code workflows enabling automated testing and deployment via version control (grafana-docs-2, grafana-docs-3, grafana-docs-26, grafana-probe-5). However, Grafana itself is primarily a server/UI product, not natively a headless automation tool — evidence shows CLI and provisioning support but no dedicated 'headless mode' or first-class automation SDK beyond config-as-code and CLI. missing for 10: dedicated headless/automation runtime documentation, independent hands-on CI usage reports, and confirmation of full API-driven operation without UI dependency.
